title: Culiacán, Sinaloa — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Culiacán, Sinaloa: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Culiacán is a city in Sinaloa with a population of 1,021,897. Capital of Sinaloa with a strong agricultural economy, vibrant culture, and the famous Las Riberas park. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
